identity_note: Matched Lightswitch Holdings (lightswitchpm.com), a New York-based multifamily property-management partnership platform led by Benton Atchison. The live domain is a one-page site; its fuller team and contact pages sit on the company's Framer site (lightswitch.framer.website), which carries the same tagline and the same CEO. Unrelated namesakes excluded: Lightswitch Capital (NY life-sciences VC), Lightswitch the lighting-design firm (SF/Chicago/NY), Lightswitch Holdings Inc. (video production, Mike Mauceri) and Ajax LightSwitch hardware.

profile.name: Lightswitch
profile.description: Tech-enabled platform that partners with (acquires stakes in) regional multifamily property-management companies, providing capital, infrastructure and institutional capabilities while keeping each manager's brand, culture and leadership.
profile.location: New York, NY (The Org; leadership based in Manhattan/Brooklyn); VP Accounting based in Tampa Bay, FL
profile.founder: Benton Atchison (Founder & CEO per The Org and LinkedIn; ex-CEO of a $100M+ roofing company, IAC, CVC, Goldman Sachs). Kamron Farman-Farmaian (President) co-founded RCH Capital Partners with him; the site does not say explicitly whether he co-founded Lightswitch.
profile.headcount: 1-10 employees (The Org, 9 people tracked); company team page names 6 people
profile.past_completed_deals: None named publicly. Site and team page describe a partnership/acquisition model for regional multifamily managers but list no partner companies as of 2026-10-08.
profile.contact_path: letschat@lightswitchpm.com (published on lightswitchpm.com); partnership inquiry form at https://lightswitch.framer.website/contact

verdict.headline: Pre-deal PM roll-up · no partners named yet
verdict.detail: Six-person NY team with M&A-finance hires (ex-Bessemer sourcing lead, PE-backed roll-up controller) but no completed deal is public.

caveats: Identity: picked the multifamily platform at lightswitchpm.com; Lightswitch Capital (VC) and a lighting-design firm share the name
Team page: lives on lightswitch.framer.website, not the live domain; same tagline and CEO, so treated as the company's own
Funding: prior pass cited RocketReach (<$5M, 2 rounds); RocketReach returned 403 today and no press confirms it, so null
Founded: no source gives a year; left null
Co-founder: Kamron Farman-Farmaian co-founded RCH Capital with Atchison; Lightswitch co-founder status not stated
Stage: batch tags it PE Growth / Series C-D, but six named staff and no public deals point to a much earlier stage
Asset Living owner: New Mountain deal reported Jun 2026; Asset Living disputed details to Bisnow
verified_note: no careers page (lightswitchpm.com/careers 404); company site and secondary sources
